system.notes:
Bash (d12). Non-hostile. A 9-foot mossy troll wedged in the mine archway, afflicted with a sneezing curse by the corruption crystals. Voice: deeply nasal, miserable — Hagrid with the world's worst head cold.

Knows: a big slimy thing in the east cavern splits when slashed; nasty snakes near the wooden bridge; the purple crystals are the source.

If cured (shatter the corruption core, then Marigold's healing): gives a Troll's Tooth — plant it in soft ground to grow a 10-ft thorny stone wall, single use.
